title: Build the pure per-session catalog coordinator
objective: Plan initial snapshots and tail deltas at sampling boundaries without editing query.go or owning persistence.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Accept current immutable snapshot, prior announced state, and context epoch.
Return either no message, an initial developer snapshot, or one coalesced developer delta.
Specify that returned catalog messages must be inserted immediately before current user input.
Treat missing/mismatched visible history as requiring a full snapshot.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Implement a pure coordinator with no provider calls.
Add first-turn, no-change, update/revoke/re-enable, epoch reset, and deterministic ordering tests.
Expose a narrow cursor result for session persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Delta is append-only and never rewrites history.
Epoch mismatch always rebuilds the current snapshot.
dispatch_prompt: Implement a pure per-session skill catalog coordinator in new loop files. Do not modify query.go, session, providers, or compaction.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
